result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with a long marked crosswalk but no pedestrian refuge. The large scale of the roadway and the presence of an overpass suggest a high-speed environment that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, across the main roadway.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and large turning radii at the intersection encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large concrete retaining wall that creates a significant blind corner at a signalized crossing. While a high-visibility crosswalk and curb ramp are present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the overgrown, narrow walkway make the area feel hostile and neglected.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The massive concrete wall obstructs sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the wall meets the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Vegetation Overgrowth
hazards.description: Weeds and debris are encroaching on the pedestrian walkway, reducing usable width.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the base of the concrete wall.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extension / Bulb-out
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to improve pedestrian visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear overgrown vegetation and debris to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is accessible.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large highway overpass, which creates a dark underpass area with significant visibility challenges. While a marked crosswalk and sidewalk are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of pedestrian-scale infrastructure make the environment feel hostile and unsafe.

hazards.name: Poor Underpass Lighting
hazards.description: The area beneath the bridge is significantly darker than the surrounding street, making pedestrians difficult to see.
hazards.location_in_image: Under the bridge structure spanning the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large concrete bridge piers create blind spots where pedestrians may be hidden from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left side of the image under the bridge

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk spans multiple lanes without a refuge island, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

interventions.title: Under-bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity LED lighting specifically for the pedestrian walkway and crossing area under the overpass.

interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island in the center of the wide crossing to allow for two-stage crossing.
